description: This file defines the class ClientControllerImpl, which implements the google::protobuf::RpcController interface for managing RPC calls within the Rialto IPC client. It includes method declarations for controlling and querying RPC call states, such as Reset, Failed, ErrorText, StartCancel, SetFailed, IsCanceled, and NotifyOnCancel. The class also manages internal state related to call failure and cancellation, protected by a mutex.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing google::protobuf::RpcController, managing RPC call states, failures, and cancellations within the Rialto IPC client.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the RPC controller to its initial state, allowing reuse for a new call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the previous RPC call has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error from the last failed RPC call.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Initiates cancellation of the ongoing RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Marks the RPC as failed with a given reason (server-side).

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled by the client.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC is canceled.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure reason for the method call.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed (overload)
methods.description: Sets the failure reason with formatted input.
